newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Berjaya Singer debt put on rating watch.
newsitem.headline: Berjaya Singer debt put on rating watch.

text.p: The debt of Berjaya Singer Bhd was put on a ratings watch following a proposal by Berjaya Group Bhd to sell its 80 percent stake in the company to a third party, Rating Agency Malaysia Bhd (RAM) said on Monday.
RAM said in a statement the rating concerned Berjaya Singer's 75 million ringgit redeemable unsecured bond issue and 30 million ringgit convertible unsecured loan stock.
The issues were earlier rated AA3 by RAM.

Berjaya Group plans to sell the Berjaya Singer stake for 1.196 billion ringgit. However, the sale is conditional on Berjaya Group able to buy back all of Berjaya Singer's subsidiary companies for around 1.317 billion ringgit.
"This may add a significant degree of uncertainty to the debt issues," RAM said.
RAM said it was in talks with Berjaya Singer's management on the on-going negotiations between the parties concerned.

RAM said the rating watch on Berjaya Singer fell under the "developing" category, "which refers to those unusual situations in which future events are so unclear that the rating potentially may be raised or lowered."
